title: La Laca de Olinalá, MEXI TV
comment: laca-olinala (MEXITV): casa-taller de cajas de laca en Olinalá, Guerrero. Caras comunes, no famosas; los cuatro se distinguen a simple vista.

chars.ISAURO_NAVA: Mexican man from Guerrero, lacquer artisan, 80 years old, thin, brown wrinkled skin, white hair combed back, a thin white mustache, a light-beige long-sleeve shirt buttoned to the neck, dark trousers, black shoes, his hands empty.
chars.GERMAN_NAVA: Mexican man, 45 years old, balding with short dark hair on the sides, rectangular glasses, a black mustache, a white dress shirt with a navy tie, grey trousers, black shoes, his hands empty.
chars.ROCIO_NAVA: Mexican woman, 42 years old, light-brown skin, shoulder-length dyed caramel hair, big sunglasses on her head, an emerald-green dress, a gold necklace, holding a small handbag.
chars.CHABELA_RUIZ: Mexican woman from Guerrero, caretaker, 50 years old, brown skin, black hair with a grey streak in a low bun, a plain lilac blouse, a white apron, dark skirt, her hands empty.

locs.LOC_PATIOLACA: Patio of a family house and lacquer workshop in Olinalá, Guerrero, at midday: a long wooden table with a simple birthday lunch and several colorful hand-painted lacquered wooden boxes with flowers and birds, small brushes and paint pots, adobe walls with orange bougainvillea, green mountains behind, warm light, no readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
